title: Galaxy determinism verification (snapshot fixtures)
description: Lock the determinism contract with committed snapshot fixtures: star chart, a sample system, and sample surface chunks must be byte-stable across runs and platforms for a given seed (supports SC-2).
acceptanceCriteria: `src/shared/galaxy/snapshots.test.ts` regenerates: full star chart (dev seed), system of star #0, system of star #1, chunks (0,0),(1,0),(0,1) of the first landable planet — and deep-equals committed JSON fixtures
Fixtures live in `src/shared/galaxy/__fixtures__/` with a README stating they must only be regenerated by an explicit deliberate command (npm run snapshot:update) after an approved generator change
Canonical serialization (stable key order) is used so JSON comparison is platform-stable

A mutation test: a test that intentionally corrupts one generator output (e.g. flips a class weight) fails the snapshot suite (verify by running the suite against a temp-modified copy or a guarded branch)
`npm run test` green; fixtures committed to the repo

steps.details: Add `src/shared/canonical.ts`: canonicalJson(value) with sorted object keys, consistent number formatting. Use in all fixtures.
Script (npm run snapshot:update) writes the six fixture files. Commit them. The default test only compares (never writes).
snapshots.test.ts loads each fixture, regenerates, deep-equals. On mismatch, print the first diff path to help debugging generator drift.
Temporarily change a generator constant, run the suite, confirm failure, revert, confirm green. Record the check in the task log.

technicalNotes: These fixtures are the regression guard for SC-2 — any generator PR that changes them must update fixtures deliberately and note the breaking seed behavior in the commit message.
